I’ve been working on a small Unity experiment called Spanda.

It explores NPC behavior through deterministic social state rather than fixed proximity rules or an LLM response layer.

This demo keeps the environment constant while changing relational state:

• identical proximity, different behavior
• scaling from 2 agents to 5
• deterministic, inspectable responses

Demo:
https://putmanmodel.itch.io/spanda-social-behavior-demo
